places-cave-of-las-mulas-de-molino-stret.story: A 306 km round trip from Esfuerzos Unidos - roughly 5 h 17 in the saddle. It goes by way of Chapel of the former hacienda of La Inmacu, Stretch of the Camino Real between Nazas a and back through Chapel of the former hacienda of La Inmacu. The highest point is about 2,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
